audience: wineries and wine traders that manage contacts, stock and sales orders in Vinsight

useCases.title: Check which sales orders are still open
useCases.text: List the sales orders with their status, invoice date and contact number. Then list the contacts to find the customer behind each open order.

useCases.title: Find a stock item by code or description
useCases.text: Search the stock items by code or description. Then read one item by its key to see the fields you need.

useCases.title: Explore any Vinsight resource with filters
useCases.text: List the resources this token can reach and describe one of them. Then list its records with filters, sort order and paging.

useCases.title: Review the order history of one customer
useCases.text: Find the customer in the contact list. Then list the sales orders for that contact number, with their status and invoice date.

useCases.title: Create a sales order for a contact
useCases.text: Look up the contact and the stock item, then create the sales order. The order takes the next number in the sequence, and no email goes to the customer.
